technical.summary: Short-term momentum is strong with golden cross and new highs, but overbought conditions (RSI 9, Stoch K) and weak intermediate/long-term structure limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: STZ shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 65 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

sentiment.summary: Weak bearish congressional signal from junior member sales (small amounts, 89-161 days old) combined with neutral market sentiment and unavailable news data yields no actionable conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (181), FOMC event in 1 day creates imminent volatility, and earnings in 65 days add binary event risk; STZ faces compounded macro and event uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with Donchian 10 new high and Awesome Oscillator cross-up provide short-term momentum confirmation for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI 9 (75.19) and Stochastic K (88.14) combined with price below 200-EMA, below Ichimoku cloud, weak intermediate trend (EMA 20/50 false), VIX crisis levels (181), inverted yield curve, FOMC event in 1 day, and earnings risk in 65 days create compounded pullback and macro event risk that overwhelms short-term momentum.
debate.price_positioning: middle_of_range — weak entry (price between support 211.16 and resistance 215.66 with no structural support below; overbought conditions suggest pullback toward support before sustainable move)

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (EMA 9/21 golden cross, Donchian new high) is present, but overbought conditions (RSI 75, Stoch 88) combined with price below 200-EMA and Ichimoku cloud indicate weak structural support for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 1 day and VIX crisis levels (181) create imminent volatility spike risk; overbought technicals suggest pullback to 211.16 support before any sustainable move, invalidating current entry timing.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical momentum insufficient to overcome macro headwinds, fundamental weakness, and event risk
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding STZ with 52 existing Consumer Staples positions (11.8% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further—skip entry and monitor for pullback setup post-FOMC.
